mapper.select: WITH owned AS ( SELECT 'f' AS slot, SRL_NO, FORM_NO, GNDR, NO, IV FROM pogo_5f UNION ALL SELECT 's' AS slot, SRL_NO, FORM_NO, GNDR, NO, IV FROM pogo_5s UNION ALL SELECT 't' AS slot, SRL_NO, FORM_NO, GNDR, NO, IV FROM pogo_5t ), bas_list AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pk.base_no AS base_no FROM owned o JOIN pokedex pk ON pk.no = o.no ), dup_raw AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.slot, pk.base_no, o.form_no FROM owned o JOIN pokedex pk ON pk.no = o.no GROUP BY o.slot, pk.base_no, o.no, o.form_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 2 ), dup AS ( SELECT slot, base_no, GROUP_CONCAT(form_no ORDER BY form_no SEPARATOR ',') AS dup FROM dup_raw GROUP BY slot, base_no ), evo_ids AS ( SELECT pk.base_no AS base_no , MAX(CASE WHEN pk.evl = 0 THEN pk.no END) AS id0 , MAX(CASE WHEN pk.evl = 1 THEN pk.no END) AS id1 , MAX(CASE WHEN pk.evl = 2 THEN pk.no END) AS id2 FROM pokedex pk JOIN bas_list bl ON pk.base_no = bl.base_no GROUP BY pk.base_no ), iv100 AS ( SELECT o.slot, pk.base_no, o.gndr AS gen, pk.evl, o.no, o.form_no, o.srl_no, pk.beta FROM owned o JOIN pokedex pk ON pk.no = o.no WHERE o.iv = 100 ), evo1_raw AS ( SELECT i.slot, i.base_no, i.gen , GROUP_CONCAT(i.no * 100 + i.form_no ORDER BY i.form_no + i.beta, i.no ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS id_ord , GROUP_CONCAT(i.no * 100 + i.form_no ORDER BY i.form_no + i.beta, i.srl_no DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS seq_ord FROM iv100 i JOIN evo_ids ei ON i.base_no = ei.base_no AND i.no = CASE i.evl WHEN 0 THEN ei.id0 WHEN 1 THEN ei.id1 WHEN 2 THEN ei.id2 END GROUP BY i.slot, i.base_no, i.gen ), evo2_raw AS ( SELECT i.slot, i.base_no, i.gen, i.evl , GROUP_CONCAT(i.no * 100 + i.form_no ORDER BY i.form_no + i.beta, i.no DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS id_ord , GROUP_CONCAT(i.no * 100 + i.form_no ORDER BY i.form_no + i.beta, i.srl_no DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS seq_ord FROM iv100 i JOIN bas_list bl ON i.base_no = bl.base_no GROUP BY i.slot, i.base_no, i.gen, i.evl ), evo2 AS ( SELECT slot, base_no, gen , MAX(CASE WHEN id_ord <> seq_ord THEN '2' ELSE '' END) AS flag FROM evo2_raw GROUP BY slot, base_no, gen ), evo_per_gender AS ( SELECT e2.slot, e2.base_no, e2.gen , CONCAT(CASE WHEN e1.id_ord <> e1.seq_ord THEN '1' ELSE '' END, IFNULL(e2.flag, '')) AS gender_flag FROM evo2 e2 LEFT JOIN evo1_raw e1 ON e1.slot = e2.slot AND e1.base_no = e2.base_no AND e1.gen = e2.gen ), evo AS ( SELECT slot, base_no , CONCAT(IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN gen = 'm' THEN gender_flag END), ''), ',', IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN gen = 'f' THEN gender_flag END), ''), ',', IFNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN gen = 'g' THEN gender_flag END), ''), ',') AS evo FROM evo_per_gender GROUP BY slot, base_no ), dup_pivot AS ( SELECT base_no , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 'f' THEN dup END) AS pogo5fDup , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 's' THEN dup END) AS pogo5sDup , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 't' THEN dup END) AS pogo5tDup FROM dup GROUP BY base_no ), evo_pivot AS ( SELECT base_no , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 'f' THEN TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM evo) END) AS pogo5fEvo , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 's' THEN TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM evo) END) AS pogo5sEvo , MAX(CASE WHEN slot = 't' THEN TRIM(TRAILING ',' FROM evo) END) AS pogo5tEvo FROM evo GROUP BY base_no ) SELECT bl.base_no , pk.dv , pk.name , dp.pogo5fDup , ep.pogo5fEvo , dp.pogo5sDup , ep.pogo5sEvo , dp.pogo5tDup , ep.pogo5tEvo FROM bas_list bl JOIN pokedex pk ON pk.no = bl.base_no LEFT JOIN dup_pivot dp ON dp.base_no = bl.base_no LEFT JOIN evo_pivot ep ON ep.base_no = bl.base_no WHERE dp.pogo5fDup IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(ep.pogo5fEvo, '') IS NOT NULL OR dp.pogo5sDup IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(ep.pogo5sEvo, '') IS NOT NULL OR dp.pogo5tDup IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(ep.pogo5tEvo, '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pk.name
